notes.title: 🎉 Let's celebrate wholesome games! 🎉❤️🎮
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Pilots! 👨‍✈️[/h2][p]We're super excited to be part of this year's [b]Wholesome Games Celebration,[/b] along with some of our favorite upcoming games! [/p][p][/p][h3]Did you know?[/h3][p]Lou's Lagoon was also [b]part of last year's Wholesome Snack Showcase[/b], hosted by the same awesome folks! Here's the trailer from back then, in case you haven't had a chance to watch it yet:

[/p][previewyoutube="lIhVm2yuI9M;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]
For the celebration, we'll have a [b]Steam broadcast up on our page for the duration of the event! [/b][/h3][p]Let our Community Manager Ines take you through the first Radio Tower Repair on Tanglebloom and some flying action, with commented gameplay! 🎮❤️[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Wholesome Recommendations[/h2][p]As we already mentioned, Lou's Lagoon is in wonderful company during this year's Wholesome Games Celebration. To spread the cozy vibes, [b]we want to highlight a few[/b] that we've been especially excited about, and all of them release(d) as part of the celebration! 🎉[/p][p][/p][h3]📚Tiny Bookshop[/h3][p]We've had an eye on this charming narrative management game since its announcement years ago! And of course, who doesn't feel the urge to lean back and open their own bookstore every once in a while? we certainly do! Now, this dream can become a (digital) reality when you open the (tiny) doors of your travelling secondhand bookstore. 🛍️[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133760/Tiny_Bookshop/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]🐦‍⬛Ritual of Raven[/h3][p]From Spellgarden Games, famous for their hit game Sticky Business, comes Ritual of Raven, a story-based farming sim in which magical constructs will do the farming for you! Colorful, witchy, and just the right amount of oddball, we're enchanted by its vibes and wil definitely give it a try—will you, too? 🪴[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066520/Ritual_of_Raven/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]💎 Gemporium[/h3][p]Mine gems, refine them, make CASH! Sounds like a simple yet intriguing gameplay loop to us! nd everything else is just a delightful bonus — like playing as a cute mole, upgrading your shop, and doing satisfying work (like polishing the gems you found). ⛏️[/p][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836100/Gemporium_A_Cute_Mining_Sim/"][/dynamiclink]

❤️ So, take your time and have fun checking out these (and more) wonderful games.
[b]Let's celebrate wholesome games together! 🎉[/b][/h3][p]
[i]~ Your Tiny Roar Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Lou's Lagoon: Behind the Scenes & What's Next!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey Pilots! ✈️[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to give you an inside look at what’s happening with Lou’s Lagoon! In this dev insight video, we’re talking about some big updates and the things we’ve been working on recently.
[/p][previewyoutube="us_WbGr_6po;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]💛🗓️[b] [/b]Here’s the big news:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Delayed Release[/b]: The release has been moved from Summer 2025 to Q1 2026. This will give us time to polish and refine the game further and we are really excited about it! 🥰
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Delayed Demo[/b]: With the release date shifted, the next demo is also delayed. We’re planning significant updates, and our goal is to make demo saves compatible with the final game (fingers crossed 🤞).
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upcoming Playtests[/b]: We want to gather feedback to help shape the game and make sure we’re on the right track. 🙂‍↕️

[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠️🎮 We also go deeper into some of the features we’re refining:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Flying[/b]: We’re adding more reasons to explore the overworld, with exciting details, loot, and improved ring challenges that include performance rankings.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building[/b]: The building system is getting an update to offer more creative freedom, allowing you to build your dream island.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adventure Vibes[/b]: We’re balancing quest-driven gameplay with a sense of exploration and discovery.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story & Writing[/b]: Our characters and story are getting extra attention, giving Lou’s Lagoon a stronger narrative identity.

[/p][/*][/list][p]Check out the full video for all the details! We’re excited to hear your thoughts and will share more updates soon. Also, we’re always super excited to chat with you over on our Discord. 💛[/p][p]
[i]- The Tiny Roar Team[/i] [/p]

notes.title: ✨Devlog: Crafting the Islands of Lou’s Lagoon!✨
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eHegS7wSsrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone! 

Our latest Lou’s Lagoon devlog is here, and this time, we’re diving deep into how we create the islands you’ll explore in the game.

This devlog focuses on Brian, our art director and level designer, who has been shaping the world of Lou’s Lagoon from the very beginning. If you’re curious about how our archipelago is coming to life, you won’t want to miss this!

Here’s what we’re covering:

[h3]📝 Concepting the Islands[/h3]
 Before an island takes shape in 3D, it all starts with concept art. We’ll be sharing early designs of the islands you’ll see in the game, as well as some ideas that didn’t make the final cut—or might return in the future!

[h3]🩶⏹️ Greyboxing: The Foundation of Level Design ⏹️🩶[/h3]
Islands aren’t just about looking good—they need to be fun to explore. The greyboxing phase ensures that each island has an interesting structure, is readable from a distance, and works well with our mechanics. We’ll show the evolution from raw geometry to fully realized environments.

[h3]🏝️ A Deep Dive into the Islands[/h3]
 Lou’s Lagoon features four major islands, each designed to be visually distinct and offer a unique gameplay experience. In this devlog, we take a closer look at:
Lou’s Island – Your cozy home base.

[list]
[*] Tanglebloom – A jungle-filled mystery.
[*] Gleam Reef – A glowing funky paradise.
[*] Boulderia – A rocky landscape tied to an enormous crab-shaped surprise.
[/list]

Oh, and one more thing… 🛩️

If you missed it, Lou’s Lagoon was featured in a recent Nintendo Direct showcase! [b]That means we’re officially coming to Nintendo Switch alongside our Steam release![/b] We’re beyond excited to bring the game to even more players, and we can’t wait for you all to explore the archipelago.

Check out the new devlog and let us know which island you’re most excited to visit! 🚀

notes.title: Devlog #2: Custom Planes, Tornadoes, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Hey pilots! 🛩️[/b]

 We’ve just dropped a brand-new Devlog, featuring a lot of exciting behind-the-scenes insights! Here’s what we’re talking about this time:


[b]✈️ Plane Customization[/b]
Lou’s Lagoon will feature different customisable plane parts: fuselages, wings, engines, patterns, and colors! In the Devlog, we share how the system for exchanging plane parts works and the challenges we faced getting everything to fit together just right.

[b]🌪️ The Tornado[/b]
Meet a new hazard in the overworld: the tornado! This segment covers the creation of the tornado’s visuals and the tech behind how it pulls your plane in. It’s a bit like a physics class in game dev!

[b]🌍 Overworld Assets[/b]
Our team has been busy creating new overworld assets, and we talk about the challenges of designing objects that look great from high up in the sky. (Fun fact: things can seem a lot smaller when you’re flying!)

[b]🏁 Air Race[/b]
We’re working on a new flying challenge! It’s not fully finished yet, but you can get an early look at it in the Devlog. We’re hoping it will shape up to add some exciting variety to the overworld!

[b][u]Check out all the details in the video here:[/u][/b]
https://youtu.be/diSv2xzX5iw


And don't forget:
[b]🎮 You Can Play the Demo Now![/b]
The tornado and some of those shiny new overworld assets are already in the demo which you can download and play right now. It’s time to see the contents of the Devlog in action!

Let us know what you think about our new Devlog and the Demo! Your feedback is important to us and we’d love to hear your thoughts! 🗨️💬

notes.title: Lou's Lagoon Demo FAQs
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT ARE THE SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS?[/h3]
[b]MINIMUM:[/b]
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10 64-bit 
[*] RAM: 4 GB 
[*] GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or similar (4 GB VRAM) 
[*] CPU: Intel Core i3-9100F or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 
[/list]
[b]RECOMMENDED [/b]
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 10 64-bit 
[*] RAM: 8 GB 
[*] GPU: GTX 1660 SUPER or similar (6+ GB VRAM) 
[*] CPU: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
[/list]
[h3]WHAT IS LOU’S LAGOON?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lou’s Lagoon is a Seaplane Delivery Service Adventure game
[*] Search for your uncle Lou, who mysteriously vanished and left you his Seaplane, while picking up and expanding his business
[*] Explore the colorful islands of the Limbo archipelago, each one with their own style, inhabitants, and hidden treasures
[/list]
[h3]WHERE CAN I DOWNLOAD THE DEMO?[/h3]
Head to our Steam page to download the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100020/Lous_Lagoon/

[h3]HOW LONG IS THE DEMO?[/h3]
That depends totally on your playstyle and how much time you take to explore the starting island and overworld! If you rush through it, you might finish it in ~15 minutes, if you take your time, it might be ~1 hour or even longer!

[h3]IS THE DEMO AVAILABLE IN MULTIPLE LANGUAGES?[/h3]
The demo is currently available in English and Simplified Chinese. We’re planning to add more languages next time around - thanks for your understanding!

[h3]ON WHICH PLATFORMS IS THE DEMO AVAILABLE?[/h3]
The demo is available through Steam.

[h3]DOES THE DEMO HAVE CONTROLLER SUPPORT?[/h3]
Yes - we even recommend controllers! Note that, depending on the controller you use, some button prompts may not be shown correctly.

[h3]CAN I SHARE SCREENSHOTS OR VIDEOS OF THE DEMO ON SOCIAL MEDIA?[/h3]
Please do! We’d be super happy to see how your adventures in the Limbo archipelago are going and we appreciate any help spreading the word about the game. 

[h3]ARE THERE ANY KNOWN BUGS OR ISSUES IN THE DEMO?[/h3]
[list]
[*] HUD UI elements may not be displayed correctly
[*] Performance may be lower around the tornado
[*] Graphical bugs may occur in the overworld environment
[*] The game cannot be exited during character creation
[*] NPC quest-markers may not appear over characters’ heads when they should
[*] Hefti might turn away when talking to you (he's not trying to be rude, just a little shy!)
[*] Button prompts are only mapped for Xbox Controllers - other controllers still work but the prompts shown may be incorrect
[/list]
[h3]WHERE CAN I REPORT BUGS?[/h3]
To report a bug, you can either press F12 in-game to directly report the issue with a screenshot attached, or[url=https://discord.gg/VfUWkQ8XX6] join our Discord[/url] server and use the dedicated channel to report bugs there. Using Discord is the best way for us to get back to you quickly!
